title: BOB Office Assistant Peon Final Result 2026
postName: Office Assistant (Peon) in Sub Staff Cadre – Regular Basis
vacancyDetails: 500 Office Assistant (Peon) posts; Mains / final merit list published state-wise and category-wise with selected and wait list
qualification: As per Bank of Baroda Office Assistant (Peon) recruitment notification 2025
ageLimit: As per BOB Peon / Office Assistant advertisement
selectionProcess: Online Preliminary Exam → Online Mains Exam → Final Merit List → Document Verification / Joining Formalities

shortDescription: Bank of Baroda Office Assistant (Peon) Mains/Final Result 2026 out on 28 July 2026 for 500 posts. Mains exam held on 22 March 2026. Check at bankofbaroda.bank.in.
content:
Bank of Baroda has declared the Mains / Final Result for recruitment of Office Assistant (Peon) in Sub Staff Cadre on a regular basis for approximately 500 posts.

The Mains examination was held on 22 March 2026 (admit card around 12 March 2026). Preliminary exam result was declared earlier (notice around March 2026). The Mains result / final merit list was published on 28 July 2026.

Result format

  • PDF with category-wise and state-wise lists
  • Selected List and Wait List (where applicable)
  • Candidates shortlisted will be called for further recruitment formalities

Download the official PDF only from bankofbaroda.bank.in Careers section and complete document verification as instructed by the bank.
